title: rookies
def: rookies: first season on the XPM board. pre-draft FV = the CBB board's draft-year FV (college players only); slot = overall pick.
views: VORX: wins over replacement, .030 x (XPM + 1.4) x MP / 48
XPM (proj): this season blended with the preseason prior by minutes (current season)
contract surplus this season: projected VORX x $ per win - salary, $M (current season)

cols.t: XPM (proj): season blended with the prior

pre.t: overall pick (year shown when drafted earlier; UDFA: undrafted)

pfv.t: draft-year FV on the CBB board, mean outcome
